# Spec: kit-tooling

Project: dsh-kit

## kit-tooling.api-facts-are-runnable

A harness fact a shipped plugin depends on must be assertable by a command that exits non-zero when the fact stops holding.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0005
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## kit-tooling.enforcement-is-checked-behaviourally

An invariant the kit enforces with a command is checked by driving the production modules and requiring the wrong verdict to be refused, so an enforcement point never rests on a test name or on output a green run prints anyway.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0009
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-gate-invariants.mjs (contains "gate invariants ok")

## kit-tooling.every-command-has-an-implementation

A declared verification command names a file that exists, because a command whose implementation is absent enforces nothing while reading as an enforcement point.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0006
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## kit-tooling.rules-name-a-declared-command

A rule the kit claims must name a command the manifest declares and whose implementation exists; a rule with no enforcement point is reported as an unverified claim rather than presented as a constraint.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0006
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## kit-tooling.verification-is-bound-to-the-code

A recorded verification names the code it judged as well as the laws it judged, so a status cannot report a clean, verified project over a tree the gate rejects.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0009
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-gate-invariants.mjs (contains "gate invariants ok")

## shipped-plugins.no-raw-tool-schemas

A plugin must not register a tool definition whose parameters or output schema was written by hand, because the registry validates those as raw JSON Schema and rejects the author DSL.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0003
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-portability.mjs

## shipped-plugins.problem-codes-are-declared

Every problem the ratchet emits carries a code from the closed vocabulary in ratchet-schema.mjs; a code invented at a call site is a defect.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0002
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.problems-carry-a-subject

A problem record carries a self-contained message and a subject, so a branch can filter on the subject and a reader can act without opening the source.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0002
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.reports-are-written-on-failure-too

An operation that produces a report writes it whether it succeeded or failed, because a report that exists only on success cannot record a failure.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0004
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.state-records-what-was-judged

A verification records the spec hash it judged, so a later reader can tell whether the code is still verified against the laws in force.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0004
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.tools-use-defineTool

Every tool a shipped plugin registers is built with defineTool, including one that takes no arguments.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0003
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.writes-are-atomic

A report reaches a reader whole or not at all, so a crash mid-write cannot be mistaken for a gate that failed.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0004
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs
